subject.title: Bug: tools.deny does not hide skill_workshop from Codex deferred tools

question: Is current-main source-path proof enough to close this tool-policy report, or should this remain open until a live Codex app-server/security repro confirms the reported leak is gone?
rationale: The current source path appears correct, but the report describes a security boundary leak observed in a live session and existing labels already ask for live reproduction and security review.
